import copy,json,work

def out(s,v,src,u): return {'status':s,'value':v,'sources':src,'unknowns':u}
# Missing required conditions are sorted and take precedence.
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{'z':1}}, [], {'required_conditions':['z','a']}) == out('unknown',None,[],['a'])
# Verification, withdrawal, condition, and claim filters.
r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}
e=[
 {'source':'wrong-claim','claim':'d','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},
 {'source':'wrong-condition','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':2},'verified':True},
 {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},
 {'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':False}]
assert work.evaluate(r,e,{'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}) == out('unknown',None,[],['no matching evidence'])
# Canonical key ordering agrees; disagreement conflicts; false is unsupported.
e2=[{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True}]
assert work.evaluate(r,e2,{'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}) == out('supported',{'a':1,'b':2},['a','b'],[])
e2[1]['value']={'a':9}
assert work.evaluate(r,e2,{'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}) == out('conflict',None,['a','b'],['source disagreement'])
assert work.evaluate(r,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'x':1}}],{'required_conditions':['x']}) == out('unsupported',False,['f'],[])
# Supersession applies only from eligible records and inputs remain unchanged.
e3=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','value':3,'conditions':{'x':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']}]
before=copy.deepcopy((r,e3))
assert work.evaluate(r,e3,{'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}) == out('supported',2,['new'],[])
assert (r,e3)==before
# Current report is exactly regenerated output and every object has exact schema keys.
with open('requests.json') as f: reqs=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
expected=[work.evaluate(q,evidence,policy) for q in reqs]
assert report==expected
assert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report)
print('comprehensive checks passed')
